title: Claim check (GET /api/tournaments/:slug/claim, 200)
description: Reader: hosted OpenPairings, before adopting a tournament key from a backup file. Request: no body; Authorization: Bearer <operator ingest token> (an installation key gets the anonymous 401); X-OpenResults-Key: the key to check. A read; it never claims. Refusals: 401 unauthorized; 403 key_required (claimed, no key sent), key_mismatch (claimed with another key); 410 tournament_deleted.

claim.description: tournament_key: the slug is claimed with exactly the presented key. unclaimed: nobody has claimed the slug, whatever was presented.
